readings.reading: the two-sided 90% interval (estimate +- t(0.95, df) SE, as REV4 3.2's 90% interval and B14's); excludes = lower end > 0 or upper end < 0, strictly; an unbounded end never excludes

readings.phrase: (not stated) a half that cannot be computed

readings.reading: B14's split exactly as sealed in strata.json (k = floor(n/2), b = the (k+1)-th smallest S, lower = {S < b}, ties at b to the higher half, so lower holds at most floor(n/2)); B16 re-derives nothing and checks the partition and the size bound; the higher half is printed, not used by the rule
